download_file_group: download a file group like odac oc adsorbml cattsunami docs or ALL from the S3 bucket
download_all_files: download all large files across all groups by passing ALL as the file group argument
change_path_for_pypi: modify file download paths to work with a PyPi-installed fairchem build instead of a git repo
fairchem_root: get the root directory path of the installed fairchem-core package as a Path object
parse_args: parse command line arguments to select which file group to download from the available choices
